# Decision: Dark mode for exports

- **Slug**: dark-mode-export
- **Decided**: 2026-10-05
- **Verdict**: kill
- **Artifacts reviewed**: intake.md, research.md

## Scorecard

| Criterion | Rating | Justification |
|-----------|--------|---------------|
| Problem validity | weak | Nobody asked for it (intake). |
| Strategic fit | weak | Exports are plain text, so a theme has nothing to style (research). |

## Verdict & Rationale

**Kill.** Nobody has asked for dark exports.

Exports are plain CSV files, so there is nothing to theme. The only real ask behind the idea is a dark viewer, which already exists.
